typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tocalypsotradeservtrade_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		CPTY_ID as decimal(38,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsotradecptyid
fromcalypsotradecptyid derive({CPTY_ID$} = toString(CPTY_ID),
		{TRADE_ID$} = toString(TRADE_ID)) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 sink(input(
		trade_id as string,
		cpty_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		trade_id = {TRADE_ID$},
		cpty_id = {CPTY_ID$}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tocalypsotradeservtrade_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tocalypsotradeservtrade
